children: Virwani moves into a business leadership role after two years across strategy and development at Embassy Group

Embassy Developments has appointed Neel Virwani as Chief Business Officer (CBO), effective September 2026. Virwani, a member of the next generation of the Embassy Group, has been associated with the organisation since 2024 and has worked across strategic planning, business development and promoter responsibilities.

Virwani is based in Mumbai in his new role, where he is responsible for developing the Group’s business presence in the market. His mandate includes market strategy, project planning and business development.

The appointment comes as Virwani moves from his earlier role as Promoter at Embassy Group, which he took up in April 2026. His current responsibilities also include supporting the Group’s expansion across markets and categories.

Virwani joined Embassy Group in April 2024 as Executive Assistant to the Chairman and Managing Director. During his two-year tenure in the role, he worked closely with Jitu Virwani, Karan Virwani and Aditya Virwani on strategic planning and business development.
He subsequently moved into the Promoter role in April 2026, before taking charge as Chief Business Officer at Embassy Developments in September.
His experience within the Group has included exposure to business planning, development initiatives and strategic decision-making across the organisation.

Alongside his real estate responsibilities, Virwani is involved with the family office and its investments. This has provided exposure to businesses, markets and investment opportunities across sectors.

His broader responsibilities bring together his experience in real estate with exposure to the Group’s investment activities. In his new role, his focus includes market development and business growth in Mumbai.
Virwani is part of the next generation of the Embassy Group and has spent the past two years building experience within the organisation before moving into a business leadership position.
He holds a Bachelor of Business Administration in Business Administration and Management from Hult International Business School, where he studied from 2019 to 2023.
The appointment places Virwani in a business-facing leadership role at Embassy Developments, with responsibilities spanning market strategy, project planning and business development.
